Sources Sought Notice
SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE
For
Calibration Verification Linearity Evaluation Services for the John D. Dingell Department of Veterans Affairs Medical Center, Detroit, MI
This is a Sources Sought Notice.  This advertisement is not a solicitation for offers, nor is it a request for quotes.  A request for quotes may be issued at a later date.
This Sources Sought/Market Survey Notice is being conducted by the Network 10 Contracting Office, 24 Frank Lloyd Wright Drive, Ste. M2200, Ann Arbor, MI 48105 to determine if responsible sources exist and if there are any businesses capable of providing the requirements listed herein.  The proposed NAICS Code is 541380, Testing Laboratories and Services ($9 Million Size Standard).
Period of Performance: 12 months from date of Award

Responses must include: (1) Business Name, GSA contract number (if applicable) and Address; (2) Point of Contact Name, Phone Number, and E-mail Address; (3) SAM UEID Number and NAICS code; (4) Business Size: are you SMALL or LARGE; and (5) Type of Business SERVICE-DISABLED VETERAN OWNED, VETERAN OWNED, 8A, HUB Zone, WOMEN-OWNED etc. All businesses eligible to provide this service are encouraged to reply as this information may be used to determine potential set asides for the above noted service. 

Prospective offerors shall respond to this Sources Sought no later than 3:00pm (Eastern), Friday, March 6, 2026. Send all replies to Cierra S. Joshua at Cierra.Joshua@va.gov. All responses shall include 36C25026Q0349 in the subject or body of the email.  

Note: This is a Sources Sought Notice only and is not a request for proposals. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this sources sought notice or any follow-up information requests.  

Please review the attached Statement of Work (SOW).
